value.rationale: A concrete, positive-data, nonuniform-transmission realization answers a specific published open occurrence question. It identifies a genuine mechanism—negative transmission-weighted invasion potential despite total population above integrated recovery/transmission threshold—and certifies an explicit extinction rate and strict mass window. This is not a renamed general fact, an arbitrary cutoff, or a boundary infection-free triviality.
